stage: TrainingTech Classification Stage 3 - Representative Semantic Evidence
purpose: Freeze human-reviewed semantic evidence for every non-protected TrainingTech structural signature without yet classifying all 287 Tech records or admitting new automatic whole-Tech rules.

reviewMethod.note: Name and Description are used only as manually reviewed source evidence for the selected representatives. The validator verifies exact source binding but does not infer semantics from text.

representativeReviews.reason: Explicit level text applies unconditional HP and ATK stat increases to all related infantry.
Explicit level text applies unconditional DEF and MDEF stat increases to all related infantry.
Explicit level text applies an unconditional HP percentage increase to all related infantry.
Explicit level text applies an unconditional ATK percentage increase to all related infantry.
Explicit level text applies an unconditional flat HP increase to all related infantry.
Explicit level text applies an unconditional flat ATK increase to all related infantry.
Explicit level text applies an unconditional ATK percentage increase in the 20-level structural signature.
Explicit level text confirms the remaining TechType 1 structural signature is also an unconditional related-army stat increase.

representativeReviews.evidenceDescription: 所有步兵，对枪兵战斗时，攻防提升<color=#DC143C>5%</color>。
representativeReviews.reason: Explicit level text conditions ATK/DEF improvement on fighting a target army type, so it is a combat-condition effect rather than a base stat node.

representativeReviews.evidenceDescription: 所有步兵，在与生命值百分比等于和低于本部队的敌军交战时，攻防提升<color=#DC143C>5%</color>。
representativeReviews.reason: Explicit level text conditions the effect on relative HP during combat.

representativeReviews.evidenceDescription: 所有飞兵和水兵，生命大于<color=#DC143C>80%</color>时，攻防提升<color=#DC143C>5%</color>。
representativeReviews.reason: Explicit level text applies a conditional combat effect to related flying and aquatic armies and demonstrates that SoldierIDRelated may coexist with a common passive.

representativeReviews.evidenceDescription: 所有水兵，在水中攻击敌军时，造成伤害提升<color=#DC143C>5%</color>。
representativeReviews.reason: Explicit level text conditions damage increase on attacking in water; SoldierIDRelated and ArmyIDRelated coexist without making the Tech Soldier growth.

representativeReviews.evidenceDescription: 所有刺客，在攻击<color=#DC143C>100%</color>生命值的敌军时，造成伤害提升<color=#DC143C>5%</color>。
representativeReviews.reason: Explicit level text conditions damage increase on the enemy's HP state and covers the no-PreTech TechType 3 structural signature.

士兵生命高于<color=#DC143C>80%</color>时，身上每有一个强化状态，则士兵攻击、防御、魔防提升<color=#DC143C>5%</color>。（最高提升15%）
representativeReviews.reason: The same Tech has SoldierIDRelated, exact SoldierSkillLevelup 1-to-10 progression, and SoldierIDUnlocked=804 on its level records. Unlock is therefore an orthogonal facet that can coexist with Soldier progression.

soldierSpecificProgressionOutsideProtect.note: These 28 Tech records are outside the Stage 2 protected canonical NORMAL Tier 3 set. Stage 3 does not assign them to the protected SOLDIER_GROWTH category.

prerequisiteAndUnlock.reason: PreTechIDs/PreTechLevel occur across common stat, common passive, and Soldier-specific progression. SoldierIDUnlocked can coexist with exact 1-to-10 Soldier progression (Tech 632).
prerequisiteAndUnlock.forbiddenStage4Behavior: Do not classify a whole Tech as PREREQUISITE_OR_UNLOCK merely because PreTechIDs, PreTechLevel, RoomLevelRequired, or SoldierIDUnlocked exists.

stage4RuleAdmissionBoundary.type2Boundary: Keep the protected 129 NORMAL Tier 3 growth Techs as SOLDIER_GROWTH. Keep the other 28 Soldier-specific progression Techs separate until Stage 4 freezes their final label/preservation treatment.

nonScope: effect/stat numeric extraction for all common Techs
reviews: The two candidate TechType whole-family rules are not automatic production rules until Stage 4 independently admits them.
The 28 non-protected TechType 2 Soldier-specific progression records need an explicit Stage 4 final label or review treatment; they must not be folded into PREREQUISITE_OR_UNLOCK.
nextStartPoint: Use this representative evidence plus the frozen Stage 1 census and Stage 2 evidence boundary to admit only independently validated whole-Tech rules. Model prerequisite/unlock as facets, preserve the protected 129 SOLDIER_GROWTH Techs, and define explicit treatment for the remaining 28 Soldier-specific progression Techs.
